gazetteer.notes: GeoNames updates this latest-export URL over time, so the recorded SHA-256 is a baseline rather than an immutable pin. New downloads must pass ZIP CRC, 19-column IN.txt country-code, and minimum-row validation before use. GeoNames data is licensed CC BY 4.0.

postal.notes: Pinned to the tracked repository archive. The upstream URL currently serves a newer snapshot with a different checksum; this URL is provenance, not a byte-for-byte download location. Do not replace the tracked file without a reviewed source/data update.

admin1.notes: Two independent HTTP 200 text/plain downloads matched this baseline and contained 3865 valid four-column rows. The latest export is checked for its row format and minimum size. Source: https://download.geonames.org/export/dump/admin1CodesASCII.txt.

admin2.notes: The HTTP 200 export retrieved on 2026-11-03 passed four-column format and minimum-size validation for 47760 rows. The SHA-256 is retained as a baseline while latest exports are validated before use. Source: https://download.geonames.org/export/dump/admin2Codes.txt.
